excerpt: Thumbmagic makes YouTube, Shorts and Reels thumbnails with AI from a video link, upload or transcript. From $17/month billed yearly. Plans and alternatives.
content:
Thumbmagic is an AI thumbnail maker for YouTube, Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels. You paste a YouTube link, upload a video or give a transcript; it picks out key moments, suggests layouts and generates several thumbnail options. You can then change the text, colours, background and facial expression in its editor without design skills, make variations for A/B tests, and export for each platform, up to 4K.

It offers templates aimed at creator niches such as gaming, with pages for Fortnite, Minecraft and Valorant, an "avatar" of your face to reuse across thumbnails, and on higher plans a feature that copies the style of a thumbnail you like. Plans start at $17 a month billed yearly for 100 thumbnails.

Thumbmagic's terms and privacy policy name TURBO STUDIO S.A.S., a company registered in Paris, France, as the operator. The site also carries the Submagic name, and sign-in and pricing live on Submagic's app.

Thumbmagic launched on Product Hunt on 23 June 2026 and finished #5 for the day, with 312 upvotes and 67 comments (as of 14 October 2026).

We have not tested Thumbmagic ourselves. This page brings together its official site, pricing page, terms and privacy policy, its Product Hunt listing and the official pricing pages of comparable tools, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.summary_short: AI thumbnail maker for YouTube, Shorts and Reels that works from a video link
use_cases: Making a thumbnail straight from a YouTube link or uploaded video
Trying several thumbnail variations for an A/B test
Reusing your own face across thumbnails with a saved avatar
Copying the style of a thumbnail you like for your own video
Agencies producing thumbnails for many channels each week

fit: publish often on YouTube, Shorts or Reels and have no designer
want several thumbnail options to test rather than one design
run a gaming or vlogging channel and want niche templates
not_fit: want a free plan: we saw only paid plans
need refunds to be clear: the pricing page promises a 30-day money-back guarantee but the terms say purchases are non-refundable
mind a licence over your uploads: the terms let the company use your content as promotional case studies unless you opt out by email

pricing.intro: Prices from Thumbmagic's pricing page on the Submagic app, in US dollars, shown as a monthly rate billed yearly. We did not see monthly-billed prices.

plans.name: Starter
plans.detail: 100 thumbnails a month, no watermark, 1 avatar, Starter templates, AI editing

plans.name: Pro
plans.detail: 500 thumbnails a month, up to 10 avatars, Pro templates, the replicate-a-thumbnail feature, 2x faster generation

plans.name: Business
plans.detail: Unlimited thumbnails and avatars, 4x faster generation, AI filters and face expressions, priority support

notes: The pricing page says plans have no setup fees, can be cancelled any time and carry a 30-day money-back guarantee.
The terms of use say all monthly and annual purchases are non-refundable, and cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period. Check with the company before buying.

alternatives.intro: Prices come from each product's own pricing page, checked on 14 October 2026.

items.name: Pikzels
items.what: AI tool for creating and testing YouTube thumbnails and titles
items.difference: Also writes and tests titles and analyses thumbnails, with credit-based pricing.

items.name: Canva
items.what: General online design tool with YouTube thumbnail templates
items.difference: You design the thumbnail yourself from templates rather than having AI generate it from your video.

pros: Works from a YouTube link, an upload or a transcript
Several options per video plus variations for A/B tests
Niche templates for gaming and other creator types
Exports sized for each platform, up to 4K
cons: Pricing page and terms disagree on refunds
Terms give the company a licence to use your content in case studies unless you opt out
The site's click-through and cost-saving figures are its own claims

x.none: We found no posts about Thumbmagic on X yet, other than its own account.

faq.a: An AI tool that generates thumbnails for YouTube, Shorts, TikTok and Reels from a video link, upload or transcript, with an editor to change text, colours, backgrounds and expressions.
Starter is $17 a month, Pro $35 and Business $59, each billed yearly. They allow 100, 500 and unlimited thumbnails a month.
We did not see one on the pricing page.
The pricing page mentions a 30-day money-back guarantee, but the terms say purchases are non-refundable. Ask the company before you pay.
Its terms and privacy policy name TURBO STUDIO S.A.S., registered in Paris, France. The site also carries the Submagic name, and its app and pricing are hosted on Submagic's site.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Thumbmagic?
faq.a: Pikzels is another AI thumbnail and title tool; Canva has thumbnail templates you edit yourself.
